admission.justification: The one-read promise is carried by the navigation hook and measured by the mounted cases that count main reads, so the statement binds two places that must agree.

applicability: Dashboard reads made when a leaf task is selected and when its reviewer is opened from the task entry.
conditions: Task entry reads no subject catalogue.
The reviewer catalogue is keyed by repository, master, leaf, history, chosen comparison number and comparison generation rather than global analytics.
An unnamed opening reads task context immediately; a late catalogue only fills navigation and does not issue a second main review.
A reader selection is its own subject read, subject to the existing retained-answer cache.
exclusions: Reads made by the reviewer's own refresh.
A subject the developer chooses, which is a read of its own.
statement: Selecting a leaf reads its summary and committed change set without a subject catalogue. Opening the reviewer reads its comparison-keyed catalogue once and one main review for the explicit target subject, or task context when none is named; a catalogue answer selects nothing.
